title: classification_result_{document_id}.json -- document type classification, one file per document v0.4
description: Assigns a type label to one document. Produced by document-pipeline's checkpoint 1 (OCR + cross-validation + classification, in one vision-model call per document -- see pipeline.md) -- one file per document (classification_result_{document_id}.json), since checkpoint 1 runs once per document and a single shared file across documents would get silently overwritten by each subsequent document's write (write-contract replaces the whole file; see known-gaps.md's audit of this exact failure mode, first found in ocr_result.json). v0.1 nested everything under a documents: [] array to cover multiple documents in one file -- v0.2 flattens that away since each file now covers exactly one document. Consumed by claim-analysis, policy-pipeline, and denial-response for document selection.

document_type_label.description: Display label in Korean (the language of the source documents). e.g. 진단서, 보험사 안내문

pre_flagged.description: True if this document's type was already known at intake (e.g. a flagged insurer-response document) rather than inferred here. When true, classification skips inference and trusts the flag -- see harness-guardrails-dev and denial-response.md.

candidate_types.description: Candidates in descending confidence order. First entry must match predicted_document_type.

evidence_references.description: Evidence for the classification. document_id may be omitted since document context is already unambiguous.

classification_source.description: How this type was decided. Two values mean NO model call was made, and both rest on the same fact -- the split cut this document's boundary on a printed title at measured precision 1.0000, so the title is recorded evidence rather than a guess needing a second opinion. 'inherited_from_parent_bundle': a deterministic text-anchor slice of an already-classified insurance_policy bundle, whose parts are policy documents by construction (see run_checkpoint1.inherited_classification). 'printed_form_title': the segment's own title NAMES a form whose type is unambiguous (진단서, 기록지, 내역서 -- see segment_case.document_type_from_title). A title naming only a genre ('REPORT' says a report exists, not which kind) never maps and falls through to the model. 'model' is a real classifier call over the page text.

inherited_from_document_id.description: The parent bundle whose classification was inherited. Required when classification_source is inherited_from_parent_bundle.

classification_text_source.description: Which text the classifier actually read. 'redacted_text' is the normal case and the one the pipeline arranges for: a split child inherits its bundle's redaction, so the redacted layer exists before the type is needed. 'raw_page_text' means no redacted_text.md existed yet and page_NNN.md was read instead -- still carrying whatever PII the page holds. That fallback is deliberate (a document not yet redacted must remain classifiable) but never silent: it sets review_required so a reviewer sees that unredacted text reached an analysis stage.

medical_classification.description: Optional fine-grained medical form kind and extraction roles. Additive to predicted_document_type: legacy classifications without this block remain valid, while a present block must distinguish a resolved kind, an explicit ambiguity, or not_medical.

human_review_uid.description: Reference to the DAO-recorded human review that cleared this classification's review_required flag. Required in practice (not by this schema) whenever classification_text_source is 'raw_page_text': document_processing refuses to finalize while any such classification lacks a valid, hash-current 'verified' record in _human_review_ledger.json. Obtained from `dao.py record-human-review --artifact-kind classification_review`; a bare name string is not a review and this field cannot be self-declared, since the DAO computes the artifact hash the record binds to. Nullable and optional so every pre-2026-08-05 classification_result still validates untouched.
